chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: Buck and Bubbles' 42-minute act and the argue-over-the-speech encore
summary: Green describes the length of the act and the encore where the two argue over who will make the speech.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I'm interested in other routines that they used to do, other sort of comedy type things, and also the kind of tap that they did and the music that they performed to.
Their act was 42-1/2 minutes, see, Buck and Bubbles.

It was actually 39-1/2 minutes, but they had an encore, which was 2-1/2 minutes, you understand? Like they'd come out and bow, and they says -- they would both say, 'Ladies and gentlemen.' Then they would look at each other and one would say, 'Go ahead, you make the speech.' 'No, you make the speech.' 'I ain't going to make no speech.' Said, 'Well, I ain't going to make no speech.' 'Well, there ain't going to be no speech.' 'Well, why didn't you say that, Look you should have said that,' and, 'If I had known that,' and so forth. Then they'd go back off stage, arguing in the wings. So that was the encore.
So they'd go off the stage arguing with each other about who was going to make the speech.
